import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

# Set backend for PNG output
matplotlib.use('Agg')

# Read the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv')

# 1. Price Distribution Histogram
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.hist(df['price'], bins=50, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Price')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Distribution of Housing Prices')
plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('price_distribution.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()
print("Saved: price_distribution.png")

# 2. Area vs Price Scatter Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(df['area'], df['price'], alpha=0.5, color='coral')
plt.xlabel('Area')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.title('House Area vs Price')
plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('area_vs_price.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()
print("Saved: area_vs_price.png")

# 3. Average Price by Furnishing Status
avg_price_by_furnishing = df.groupby('furnishingstatus')['price'].mean()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
avg_price_by_furnishing.plot(kind='bar', color='mediumseagreen', edgecolor='black')
plt.xlabel('Furnishing Status')
plt.ylabel('Average Price')
plt.title('Average House Price by Furnishing Status')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('avg_price_by_furnishing.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()
print("Saved: avg_price_by_furnishing.png")

print("\nAll visualizations generated successfully!")
